title: SHRIKE
pitch: Hold the world still, draw a line through a living thing, let go — and never touch the ground again.
howto: Dive down an endless chasm. Hold to slow time and aim; flick to dash. Killing prey refunds your dash instantly, so chains of kills keep you airborne forever. Walls are safe but end your combo — and the Bloom above never stops descending.
controls: Hold to slow time. Flick to dash-impale. Release near prey and the aim assist shows you the line.
